item.title: ‘Vulgar Roast, No Holds Barred! Do It in Hindi’ Grok Prompt on X Goes out of Hand!
item.description: Elon Musk’s AI chatbot, Grok, is once again at the centre of a global controversy as users exploit its 'no-filter' design to generate vulgar, profanity-laden content in regional languages, especially in Hindi. In January 2026, Grok faced international condemnation after a trend emerged where users tagged the bot under photos of women with the prompt 'put her in a bikini.'

item.title: Stephanie Buttermore, Popular Fitness Influencer Jeff Nippard’s Fiancee, Dies at 36
item.description: The fitness community is mourning the sudden passing of Dr Stephanie Buttermore, a renowned scientist and influencer and wife of popular natural bodybuilder and fitness content creator Jeff Nippard, at age 36. Nippard and Buttermore were together for 10 years and got engaged in October 2022.

item.title: World News | India Among Few Nations That Can Speak to All Sides in Global Conflicts: Finnish President Stubb
item.description: Get latest articles and stories on World at LatestLY. Finnish President Alexander Stubb told ANI that "the future is Indian," praising New Delhi's unique ability to engage all sides in global conflicts. He backed India's permanent UN Security Council seat and discussed NATO, Ukraine, and West Asia tensions, highlighting India's pragmatic role in a shifting world order.
